newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firms, premiums steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firms, premiums steady.

text.p: NWE jet fuel rose on stronger IPE gas oil futures on Monday but trade was quiet and premiums were stable, traders said.
November IPE futures rose $3.75 to $223.50 a tonne.
Traders said there was interest in barges for late November with offers at around Dec +$32.00/32.75.
NWE cargoes were discussed at around Dec +$32, a shade higher than trades on Thursday at Dec +$31.5, but one trader valued large cargoes at Dec +$28 with small parcels at $33.
There was no shortage of offers and bids but trade was stymied by difficulties in matching availability to buyers' required destinations and size of cargo, traders said.
